news.latest-news.pope-leo-has-a-good-sec: Pope Leo shows steady improvement at Gemelli
news.latest-news.the-holy-see-press-offi: Pope Leo XIV's doctors say October 16 blood tests and a chest X-ray confirmed steady improvement in his overall condition. Respiratory physiotherapy continues, and he can carry out normal daily activities independently. The Holy See Press Office says he celebrated Mass at noon for members of Gemelli's medical and nursing staff and the Vatican Gendarmerie, thanking those who care for the sick.
news.latest-news.aoun-invoked-saint-char: Aoun invoked Saint Charbel's intercession for Pope Leo XIV's recovery, conveying the Lebanese people's prayers in a message to the pontiff, LBC reported. He said the pope's visit to Lebanon remains firmly rooted in the hearts and the national and spiritual consciousness of the Lebanese, regardless of their religious affiliation.
news.latest-news.catholics-pray-for-pope: Catholics Pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli
news.latest-news.an-evening-rosary-was-h: An evening Rosary was held in Gemelli Hospital's chapel on October 13, presided over by Cardinal Baldassarre Reina, according to Catholic News Service reporting published by the USCCB. Churches and religious communities in Rome were also invited to join in prayer. The Holy See later reported that the Pope's operation was completed successfully.

news.latest-news.on-his-fifth-day-at-gem: Pope Leo XIV was discharged from Gemelli Hospital on Saturday afternoon following lung surgery on Tuesday and returned to the papal apartments in Vatican City. Before leaving, he celebrated Mass in the room set aside for that purpose on the 10th floor. On Sunday at noon he will lead the Angelus from the window of the Apostolic Palace.
